_comment: Real stage 1 config for the four Loggers, derived from the Logger programs in M:/0373-03/Logger_Data/Logger_Programs.
Keys starting with an underscore are comments and are ignored.
Raw files are found under each Logger's folder and all its subfolders (year and Week_NN folders); Card folders are never read.
A Raw file is mapped by the date in its name (Logger clock, inclusive ranges) and its column count; files that match no mapping are skipped and listed in the result.

VERIFIED (2026-11-02): all four programs (Hub_2020_09_04_005/006, Nacelle_2020_09_04_008 and Nacelle_2021_08_24_009, Tow_Bot_2020_09_04_009, Tow_Top_2020_09_04_006) call NetworkTimeProtocol("10.0.0.4", -4, 10) in a 24 h SlowSequence, so every Logger clock is UTC-4 (ADR 0002), including Nacelle and Tower_Top.

TOA5 files (2024-09 onward, header lines then rows with a TIMESTAMP column) are read in the same folders as headerless files. `clock_offset_hours` (default -4) applies to headerless files only; `toa5_clock_offset_hours` (default 0, UTC, ADR 0003) applies to TOA5 files. A TOA5 file's Channel names and units must equal a mapping's, else it is skipped and listed.

NOT VERIFIED: the clock offset was checked in the programs only, not against current-year files (no Nacelle, Tower_Top or Tower_Bot files exist under the 2026 folders at the time of writing; Hub 2026 files were not compared with an external clock).

NOT VERIFIED: the exact dates where a Logger program changed. Hub 12 -> 15 channels and Nacelle 15 -> 12 channels are dated from the program file dates (Hub_..._006 saved 2021-08-23, Nacelle_..._009 saved 2021-08-24); a Raw file in the gap fails the column-count check and is skipped and listed.
NOT VERIFIED: programs 001-004 (Aug-Sep 2020) of every Logger were not read; Raw files before 2020-09-04 are unmapped and would be skipped.
Units are taken from the Units lines of the programs; Nacelle Pitch_Speed (2020 program) has no Units line, mV is assumed.

channel_mappings._comment: Program Hub_2020_09_04_005: 12 blade bridges, 12 columns after the 5 meta columns (confirmed on Hub_Data_2020_09_04_1823.csv).
Program Hub_2020_09_04_006 (latest): 12 blade bridges plus 3 azimuth accelerometer channels = 15 (confirmed on hub_data_2025_08_17_0009.csv).
Program Nacelle_2020_09_04_008: 15 channels (confirmed on nacelle_data_2020_09_04_1823.csv). Pitch_Speed has no Units line in the program.
Program Nacelle_2021_08_24_009 (latest): 12 channels. The card file nacelle_data.csv (TOA5 header) does not match the name pattern and is ignored.

Tower_Top._comment: Program Tow_Top_2020_09_04_006 (latest): 3 channels (confirmed on tow_top_data_2020_09_04_1823.csv). Earlier programs 001-005 not read.

Tower_Bot._comment: Program Tow_Bot_2020_09_04_009 (latest): 2 channels (confirmed on tow_bot_2020_09_04_1823.csv and tow_bot_2021_*.csv). The data folder is Tower_Bottom, the programs folder is Tower_Bot.
